name: tournyx-esports-app
description: Tournyx Esports Cross-Platform App (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS)

scripts.cap:sync: npm run prep:www && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run prep:www && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs android && node scripts/build-icons.mjs android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run prep:www && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios && node scripts/build-icons.mjs ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.tauri:icons: node scripts/build-icons.mjs source && npx tauri icon assets/icon-only.png
scripts.tauri:dev: npm run prep:www && npx tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: npm run prep:www && npx tauri build
